title: USD price behaviour and risk conditions at the 05:00 London cutoff

assigned_to.note: One frontier model fills the cards. It must not see the reviewer packages or the coordinator's expectations.

target_contract.endpoint: 05:00 Europe/London on the next local date (05:00Z in GMT, 04:00Z in BST); one 24-hour London-to-London session
target_contract.label: sign of the label-instrument change from cutoff to endpoint, flat band frozen separately
target_contract.instrument: DXY, quote source UNVERIFIED; the researcher must state which instrument a claim is actually about

coordinator_context_allowed: Inventory of the deployed engine: docs/research/usd-session/v1/inventory.md

Data actually reachable in this repository (read-only): data/usd-24h-research-dataset.json and its manifest, backtester/tmp/oanda_eur_usd_h1.csv, oanda_xau_usd_h1.csv, oanda_nas100_usd_h1.csv, data/backtester-checker-usd-24h-2024-01.json
coordinator_analysis_withheld: No expected sign, no expected size, no preference for any candidate, and no accuracy figure from the 24-hour study is sent with this assignment.
cards_to_produce: fx.usd-session-momentum (trailing move over 1d and 5d, continuation versus fade)
fx.usd-overnight-range-position (where the dollar sits in its own recent range at the cutoff)
fx.usd-session-volatility-regime (realised volatility and its effect on the expected move and on abstention)
risk.risk-on-off-cross-asset-state (equities, credit, gold, crypto at the cutoff)
risk.usd-safe-haven-demand (whether the dollar is being bought as insurance)
data.quality-gate-for-abstention (which data states should force abstention rather than a weak call)
questions_every_card_must_answer: What is the mechanism inside this specific 24-hour London-to-London session?
When does the relation change sign, weaken, or stop being informative because it is already priced?
Is the factor direction, regime context, a quality gate or an abstention gate?
What exactly was observable at 05:00 London, and how stale is each input?
What is the programmable hypothesis, what parameter values are allowed, and what result would kill it?
Which other cards share the same information, and what would be double-counted?

deliverable.format: one JSON file per card following docs/research/usd-session/v1/research-card.schema.json
deliverable.must_also_return: a short note listing sources fetched with links, and any question the model could not resolve

rules: Do not consult or reproduce the coordinator's own conclusions; the package withholds them.
Do not propose new thresholds that cannot be computed from the listed data.
State plainly when an input is unavailable rather than substituting a proxy silently.
A card may conclude that the factor should not be used.
No production, workflow, dashboard or configuration change is authorised by this assignment.
